title: incident-bot: oncall autodiagnostics heuristics + slo-toolkit runbook hints
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: on-call teams reported that runbook suggestions and automated diagnostics returned low-relevance links during noisy SLO degradations, increasing time-to-ack and remediation. This PR improves incident-bot autodiagnostics heuristics and adds a lightweight set of SLO-toolkit runbook hints to boost relevance of suggested actions. The change combines: 1) heuristics to detect correlated KPI patterns across error-rate, tail-latency, and infra saturation; 2) runbook hint scoring that weights recent successful runbook matches and customer-specific overrides; 3) defensive fallbacks when telemetry is incomplete. This PR is intentionally conservative: it tunes suggestion scoring and adds feature flags so behavior can be rolled back quickly.
commits: feat: add multimetric correlation matcher and priority scoring (incident-bot/src/diagnostics/correlation.py)
feat: integrate runbook-hint scoring into suggestion pipeline and expose feature flag (incident-bot/src/suggestions/hints.py)
chore: add unit and integration tests + mock fixtures for SLOToolkit (slo-toolkit/tests/*)
review_comments: Jordan Lee: Can we avoid adding a heavy dependency? The correlation matcher looks CPU-intensive in worst case.
Avery Chen: The matcher is implemented as a streaming windowed comparator and uses existing metrics index; added unit tests and a load guard to limit scan size (see correlation.py).
Priya Nayar: Please add a short note about feature flag behavior and default rollout in the docs.
Avery Chen: Added feature_flags.yaml and docs/incident-bot/runbook-hints.md describing rollout plan and rollback.
Luca Romano: Integration test failed on first run (flake) — reran and passed. Also requested clearer telemetry fallback logic.
Avery Chen: Improved fallback priority ordering and added a simulated missing-metrics test case.
notes_on_testing: Added deterministic fixtures that simulate SLO spikes and missing telemetry scenarios. Integration test initially failed due to flaky metrics emulator; fixed timing and retried CI. Local benchmarking shows suggestion latency increase of ~4ms p95 under typical load with small CPU overhead because matcher uses bounded windows.
operational_impact: Default rollout is behind feature flag 'oncall_autodiag_v2' and is off for all orgs. We will enable for internal staging first and ramp to 10% of customers. Contains safe fallbacks to previous suggestion logic if scoring confidence < 0.3.
release_notes: Improves on-call runbook suggestion relevance by adding multi-metric correlation heuristics and runbook hint scoring. Feature gated; disabled by default. No breaking changes.
post_merge_actions: Turn on feature flag for staging namespace via infra toggle (ops runbook)
Monitor suggestion precision/recall metrics (dashboards added under incident-bot -> suggestions)
If precision drops >5 percentage points, revert flag and notify SRE
